brief: 9 GitHub repos serious devs star but rarely talk about.

slots.toolTagline: Run GitHub Actions locally without pushing a single commit.
slots.bodyText: Test your CI workflows in a clean Docker environment before they ever hit the remote. Saves time and avoids embarrassing red builds on main.
slots.skill1Body: Runs GitHub Actions locally in Docker containers.
slots.skill2Body: Debugging failing CI steps before pushing code.
slots.skill3Body: One binary install via brew or cargo.
slots.skill4Body: Docker must be running locally to execute jobs.

slots.toolTagline: Auto-load environment variables when you cd into a project folder.
slots.bodyText: Stop exporting secrets globally. direnv unloads them automatically when you leave the directory, keeping your shell pristine.
slots.skill1Body: Loads and unloads env vars based on directory.
slots.skill2Body: Managing API keys across multiple codebases.
slots.skill3Body: Hook into your shell once, then add .envrc files.
slots.skill4Body: Remember to allow each .envrc with direnv allow.

slots.toolTagline: A syntax-highlighting pager that makes your diffs beautiful and readable.
slots.bodyText: Replace the default git pager with delta to get side-by-side views, line numbers, and hyperlinks right inside your terminal.
slots.skill1Body: Renders Git diffs with syntax highlighting and themes.
slots.skill2Body: Reviewing large pull requests in the terminal.
slots.skill3Body: Set core.pager in gitconfig and install the binary.
slots.skill4Body: Configure your BAT_THEME for consistent color output.

slots.toolTagline: Benchmark any command with statistical analysis and warmup runs built in.
slots.bodyText: Compare script performance across languages or flags. Handles outliers, clears caches between runs, and exports clean JSON for plotting.
slots.skill1Body: Measures execution time with statistical rigor and warmup.
slots.skill2Body: Comparing regex engines, compilers, or build scripts.
slots.skill3Body: Single binary available on all major package managers.
slots.skill4Body: Close background apps to reduce noise in results.

slots.toolTagline: A lightweight, self-hosted Git service that runs on a Raspberry Pi.
slots.bodyText: Host your own repos without the bloat of GitLab. One binary, minimal RAM, and full CI support via Actions or Drone.
slots.skill1Body: Self-hosted GitHub alternative with issues and PRs.
slots.skill2Body: Private teams and homelab infrastructure projects.
slots.skill3Body: Single Docker container or binary in minutes.
slots.skill4Body: Backups are your responsibility; schedule them early.

slots.toolTagline: Continuous file synchronization that works across all your machines privately.
slots.bodyText: Drop Dropbox. Syncthing uses block-level sync over TLS, keeps data off third-party servers, and plays nice with dotfiles repos.
slots.skill1Body: P2P folder sync with versioning and encryption.
slots.skill2Body: Dotfiles, notes, and project folders across devices.
slots.skill3Body: Install, share device IDs, and pick folders.
slots.skill4Body: Keep devices online for real-time bidirectional syncing.

slots.ctaBody: Add these repos to your toolkit and thank yourself later. Serious devs build in silence.
